provenance.run_harness: modal_ablations.py, before the hash-keyed cache/checkpoint harness existed
provenance.limitation: This artifact predates the provenance harness used by labelling_ablation_result.json and cascade_matched_result.json. Its shards and checkpoints were keyed by split/index and arm name only, so a rerun cannot be proven to reuse the same inputs. The LABELLING arms from this run are superseded by validation/labelling_ablation_result.json, which holds the loss weights fixed and carries a full manifest. Only the CASCADE (truncation-augmentation) arms are still cited from here, and the paper reports that comparison as not supporting its causal claim - a negative result, so the provenance gap does not prop up a positive finding.
